nodes.description: Adds a single line item to an existing goods receipt. Only free goods receipts (those without a supplier order or return order origin) in `draft` or `created` state accept line item writes; anything else is rejected. Returns the updated goods receipt.
nodes.name: mutation.addGoodsReceiptLineItem

nodes.description: Adds a new (product, supplier) supplier configuration. Its purchase price is maintained in the currency of the supplier.
nodes.name: mutation.addProductSupplierConfiguration

nodes.description: Puts a discount position on a quote and recalculates the quote. The amount is deducted from the quote total and its tax is derived from the tax buckets of the merchandise already on the quote, so add the merchandise first. Only a quote in state `draft` can be changed — any other state fails the mutation. Returns the recalculated quote.
nodes.name: mutation.addQuoteCredit

nodes.description: Puts a free-text position on a quote and recalculates the quote. Unlike a product position it refers to no catalog product and states its own label, price and tax rate. Only a quote in state `draft` can be changed — any other state fails the mutation. Returns the recalculated quote.
nodes.name: mutation.addQuoteCustomLineItem

nodes.description: Puts a catalog product on a quote and recalculates the quote. The position is priced from the product's price in the quote's sales channel; change it with `updateQuoteLineItem`. Only a quote in state `draft` can be changed — any other state fails the mutation. Returns the recalculated quote.
nodes.name: mutation.addQuoteProductLineItem

nodes.description: Adds a single line item to an existing supplier order via the existing SupplierOrderLineItemCreationService, then recalculates the order. Returns the updated supplier order.
nodes.name: mutation.addSupplierOrderLineItem

nodes.description: Applies a relative delta (positive or negative) to the stock at a (product, bin location[, batch]) tuple. Writes one stock movement against the stock-correction special location. Returns the stock row of the bin location, or `null` when the bin location holds no stock afterwards and is not the default bin location of the product.
nodes.name: mutation.adjustStockAtBinLocation

nodes.description: Applies a relative delta (positive or negative) to the per-warehouse stock total for a (product, warehouse[, batch]) tuple. Writes one stock movement against the stock-correction special location.
nodes.name: mutation.adjustStockAtWarehouse

nodes.description: Approves a goods receipt that has been captured.
nodes.name: mutation.approveGoodsReceipt

nodes.description: Cancels the outstanding quantity of every open line item of a supplier order, for when the supplier will not deliver the remainder. The outstanding quantity leaves the incoming stock so demand planning can reorder, while the ordered quantity, the line prices and the order total stay unchanged; once nothing is open any more the order settles to DELIVERED on its own. The cancelled quantity is never given: whatever is open at the moment of the call is cancelled, and an order with nothing open is left untouched. Prefer this over lowering an ordered quantity, which falsifies the order document. A supplier order without an approved goods receipt has received nothing, so cancelling its remainder would mark the whole order as one the supplier never delivered: the mutation fails with `CONFLICT` there, and cancelling the supplier order is the right action instead.
nodes.name: mutation.cancelOpenSupplierOrderQuantities

nodes.description: Cancels a supplier order via the cancel state-machine transition.
nodes.name: mutation.cancelSupplierOrder

nodes.description: Changes the shipping address of a fulfillment order, e.g. to send part of an order to another recipient. From then on the fulfillment order keeps this address, even when the shipping address of the order changes afterwards. Only a fulfillment order in state `Open`, `InProgress` or `OnHold` can be changed. Shipping labels created afterwards are addressed to the new address; existing ones stay as they are.
nodes.name: mutation.changeFulfillmentOrderShippingAddress

nodes.description: Completes a goods receipt: triggers the stocking work and the underlying state-machine transition.
nodes.name: mutation.completeGoodsReceipt

nodes.description: Creates a new batch row for the given product. The (productId, number) tuple must be unique.
nodes.name: mutation.createBatch

nodes.description: Creates a customer along with its default billing/shipping address. The customer number is generated from the `customer` number range when omitted, and the language is inherited from the sales channel. Returns the created customer.
nodes.name: mutation.createCustomer

nodes.description: Creates a goods receipt with the given warehouse, optional supplier and line items in one shot.
nodes.name: mutation.createGoodsReceipt

nodes.description: Creates an empty quote in state `draft` for the given customer and sales channel. Everything else is derived: the quote number from the `quote` number range, the currency and its rounding and the tax handling from the sales channel, and the shipping and payment method from the sales channel defaults — each recorded as a snapshot on the quote. The result carries no line items and a total of zero, so it is not yet something to send to a customer; add line items and prices before doing so. Requires quotes to be enabled for the shop; the mutation fails with `FORBIDDEN` otherwise.
nodes.name: mutation.createQuote

nodes.description: Creates a new supplier. Only `name` is required: `number` is drawn from the supplier number range, `languageId` defaults to the system default language and `currencyId` to the system default currency when omitted. An optional `address` populates the supplier's address record.
nodes.name: mutation.createSupplier

nodes.description: Creates a draft supplier order with the given header data and line items, then recalculates totals. The order is raised in the supplier's currency unless `currencyId` names another one.
nodes.name: mutation.createSupplierOrder

nodes.description: Creates a new warehouse. Fills in admin defaults (stock available for sale, default warehouse location, active status) for any field the caller omits.
nodes.name: mutation.createWarehouse

nodes.description:
Subscribes the calling token to a topic. The destination is registered with the delivery service and the
subscription is stored right away, with `consentState: Pending`. Deliveries start once the destination has
consented to the handshake the delivery service performs; until then nothing is sent. The response is the
only place the `signingSecret` is ever returned.

Besides `webhook_subscriptions:write`, the token needs read access to the topic's subject type — the scope
listed for the topic, e.g. `orders:read` for `order/completely-shipped`. Without it the mutation fails with
`FORBIDDEN`.
nodes.name: mutation.createWebhookSubscription

nodes.description: Deletes a bin location. Fails when the bin still holds stock.
nodes.name: mutation.deleteBinLocation

nodes.description: Deletes a goods receipt that is still in a deletable state.
nodes.name: mutation.deleteGoodsReceipt

nodes.description: Deletes a supplier order and its line items as part of the same transaction.
nodes.name: mutation.deleteSupplierOrder

nodes.description: Deletes a warehouse. Delegates to WarehouseDeletionService which fixes up irrelevant stock and rejects deletion when relevant stock remains.
nodes.name: mutation.deleteWarehouse

nodes.description: Deletes a subscription. Notifications that have not been delivered yet are discarded.
nodes.name: mutation.deleteWebhookSubscription

nodes.description: Fulfills the given quantities of a fulfillment order from one warehouse of its location: the stock is booked out and a fulfillment is created, while the rest stays open in the fulfillment order. Only a fulfillment order in state `Open` or `InProgress` that is fulfilled in Pickware can be fulfilled. A quantity above the quantity still to fulfill or above the stock in the warehouse fails the mutation, and nothing is fulfilled. For an order that an external shop system such as Shopify manages, the fulfillment is reported to that system as well; when it rejects the fulfillment, nothing is fulfilled. Line items left out or with quantity 0 are not fulfilled; when nothing is to be fulfilled, the fulfillment order is returned unchanged. The order's delivery status and the flows react as when shipping in the Administration. Returns the fulfillment order, whose `fulfillments` include the one created.
nodes.name: mutation.fulfillFulfillmentOrder

nodes.description: Transitions a supplier order to the CONFIRMED state.
nodes.name: mutation.markSupplierOrderAsConfirmed

nodes.description: Transitions a supplier order to the SENT state (sent to supplier).
nodes.name: mutation.markSupplierOrderAsOrdered

nodes.description: Transitions a supplier order to the PAID payment state.
nodes.name: mutation.markSupplierOrderAsPaid

nodes.description: Transitions a supplier order to the PARTIALLY_PAID payment state.
nodes.name: mutation.markSupplierOrderAsPartiallyPaid

nodes.description: Transitions a supplier order back to the OPEN payment state.
nodes.name: mutation.markSupplierOrderAsUnpaid

nodes.description: Moves a fulfillment order to another location, which then picks and ships it. Only a fulfillment order in state `Open` that is fulfilled in Pickware and is not being picked can be moved, and stock at the new location is not checked. Moving it to the location it is already assigned to changes nothing. When nothing of the fulfillment order is fulfilled yet, the fulfillment order itself moves. When it is partially fulfilled, its fulfilled quantities stay at the old location and it is closed, and a new fulfillment order at the new location takes over the open quantities. For an order that an external shop system such as Shopify manages, the move is made in that system: only locations connected to it can be chosen, and line items it does not stock at the new location stay at the old one. Returns the fulfillment order that is fulfilled from the new location: the moved one, or the new one.
nodes.name: mutation.moveFulfillmentOrderToLocation

nodes.description:
Re-activates a subscription that was disabled automatically. The destination has to consent in a fresh
handshake, and an escalating cooldown after the automatic disable has to have elapsed — while it is running
the mutation fails with `CONFLICT` and a `reactivationBlockedUntil` error extension.
nodes.name: mutation.reactivateWebhookSubscription

nodes.description: Removes a single line item from a goods receipt. Only free goods receipts (those without a supplier order or return order origin) in `draft` or `created` state accept line item writes; anything else is rejected. Returns the updated goods receipt.
nodes.name: mutation.removeGoodsReceiptLineItem

nodes.description: Deletes a (product, supplier) configuration row. The associated purchase-list item is unlinked when present.
nodes.name: mutation.removeProductSupplierConfiguration

nodes.description: Takes a line item off its quote and recalculates the quote. Works for every kind of position, credits included. Only a quote in state `draft` can be changed — any other state fails the mutation. Returns the recalculated quote.
nodes.name: mutation.removeQuoteLineItem

nodes.description: Removes a supplier order line item and recalculates the order. Returns the updated supplier order.
nodes.name: mutation.removeSupplierOrderLineItem

nodes.description: Sets (or clears) the default bin location for a product in a warehouse. Upserts the `(product, warehouse)` configuration row: an existing row is updated, otherwise a new row is created with a reorder point of 0. Passing `binLocationId: null` clears the default bin location. Returns the resulting configuration row, or `null` when the row is left without a default bin location and without reorder thresholds (`reorderPoint` 0, no `targetMaximumQuantity`): such a row serves no purpose and is removed.
nodes.name: mutation.setProductDefaultBinLocation

nodes.description: Makes a supplier the default supplier of a product, replacing the previous default supplier if the product has one. The supplier must already be configured for the product (see `addProductSupplierConfiguration`). Like changing the default supplier in the Administration, this copies the purchase price of the new default supplier to the product. Returns the configuration row of the new default supplier.
nodes.name: mutation.setProductDefaultSupplier

nodes.description: Sets the product-level reorder thresholds (`reorderPoint` and `targetMaximumQuantity`) that apply across all warehouses. Returns the updated product.
nodes.name: mutation.setProductReorderConfiguration

nodes.description: Sets the replenishment thresholds (`reorderPoint` and `targetMaximumQuantity`) for a product at a stock location. Pass a `binLocationId` to target a specific bin location, or omit it to target the warehouse-level "unknown" location. Upserts the configuration row (and its product-stock-location mapping when it does not yet exist) and returns the resulting configuration row. Returns `null` when both thresholds are empty (`reorderPoint` `null` or 0, no `targetMaximumQuantity`): such a configuration serves no purpose and is removed, together with its mapping when the stock location holds no stock of the product.
nodes.name: mutation.setProductStockLocationReorderConfiguration

nodes.description: Sets the replenishment thresholds (`reorderPoint` and `targetMaximumQuantity`) for a product in a warehouse. Upserts the `(product, warehouse)` configuration row: an existing row is updated, otherwise a new row is created. Returns the resulting configuration row, or `null` when both thresholds are empty (`reorderPoint` `null` or 0, no `targetMaximumQuantity`) and no default bin location is set: such a row serves no purpose and is removed.
nodes.name: mutation.setProductWarehouseReorderConfiguration

nodes.description: Sets the absolute stock quantity for a (product, bin location[, batch]) tuple. Computes the delta against the current stock and writes one stock movement against the stock-correction special location. Returns the stock row of the bin location, or `null` when the bin location holds no stock afterwards and is not the default bin location of the product.
nodes.name: mutation.setStockAtBinLocation

nodes.description: Sets the absolute stock quantity for a (product, warehouse[, batch]) tuple. Computes the delta against the current per-warehouse total and writes one stock movement against the stock-correction special location.
nodes.name: mutation.setStockAtWarehouse

nodes.description: Merges the given custom fields into the supplier order. The payload is a JSON object keyed by custom field technical name; keys not present in the payload keep their current value, and a key present with value null is stored as null. Only keys defined for supplier orders are accepted. Returns the updated supplier order.
nodes.name: mutation.setSupplierOrderCustomFields

nodes.description: Ships every still-shippable quantity of the given order from the chosen warehouse in a single transaction. When `warehouseId` is omitted, the shop's configured default warehouse is used. Returns the freshly loaded order. Fails without shipping anything when the warehouse does not hold enough stock for the open quantities, when the warehouse is being decommissioned, when the order is currently being picked, or when its fulfillment is on hold or assigned to another warehouse. Tracking codes cannot be passed; the shipment takes over the tracking codes already stored on the order's delivery.
nodes.name: mutation.shipOrderCompletely

nodes.description: Splits a line item in two: a new line item is created with `newLineItemQuantity` units and the original keeps the remainder, so the received total stays the same. Use it to stock parts of one receipt line separately. The quantity must be lower than the line item's current quantity, and the goods receipt must not be completed yet. Returns the updated goods receipt.
nodes.name: mutation.splitGoodsReceiptLineItem

nodes.description: Moves the given quantity of a product from one bin location to another in a single stock movement. Source and destination must differ; quantity must be positive.
nodes.name: mutation.transferStock

nodes.description: Changes the customer number of an existing customer, e.g. to the number the customer holds in a POS, accounting or legacy system. Fails with `CONFLICT` when another customer already holds the number. Returns the updated customer.
nodes.name: mutation.updateCustomerNumber

nodes.description: Changes the warehouse the goods are booked into and re-snapshots it on the receipt. Rejected once the goods receipt is part of a stock valuation report. Returns the updated goods receipt.
nodes.name: mutation.updateGoodsReceiptWarehouse

nodes.description: Partial update of an existing (product, supplier) configuration. Omitted fields are not touched. The purchase price is maintained in the currency of the supplier; supplying only one of `purchasePriceGross` / `purchasePriceNet` keeps the other side of the current price.
nodes.name: mutation.updateProductSupplierConfiguration

nodes.description: Changes the label and the amount of a discount position, then recalculates the quote. A position that is not a credit is rejected; use `updateQuoteLineItem` for those. Only a quote in state `draft` can be changed — any other state fails the mutation. Returns the recalculated quote.
nodes.name: mutation.updateQuoteCredit

nodes.description: Changes the quantity, the unit price, the label and — on a free position — the tax rate of a quote line item, then recalculates the quote. This is how a quote departs from the list price. An omitted field keeps its current value, and a `quantity` of `0` takes the position off the quote. A credit position is rejected; use `updateQuoteCredit` for those. Only a quote in state `draft` can be changed — any other state fails the mutation. Returns the recalculated quote.
nodes.name: mutation.updateQuoteLineItem

nodes.description: Partial update of an existing supplier. Omitted fields are not touched. A supplied `address` is merged field-by-field into the supplier's address record, which is created on the fly when the supplier has none yet.
nodes.name: mutation.updateSupplier

nodes.description: Updates the expected delivery date on a supplier order and all of its line items. Pass null to clear it.
nodes.name: mutation.updateSupplierOrderExpectedDeliveryDate

nodes.description: Updates the quantity and/or unit price of a supplier order line item via the line item priceDefinition. Triggers an order recalculation. Returns the updated supplier order.
nodes.name: mutation.updateSupplierOrderLineItem

nodes.description: Creates a bin location with the given code in the given warehouse, or updates the existing bin location position if a row with the same (warehouseId, code) already exists. Returns the resulting bin location row.
nodes.name: mutation.upsertBinLocation

specification.text:

  "Capability strings (`<technical_name>:<level>`). The caller must hold at least one entry."
  anyOf: [String!]

  "Capability strings (`<technical_name>:<level>`). The caller must hold every entry."
  allOf: [String!]
) on FIELD_DEFINITION

"Any entity that can be loaded by its global id through the `node(id: ID!)` query."
interface Node {
  "Global identifier for this entity."
  id: ID!
}

"""
Whether the destination currently consents to receiving webhooks. Nothing is delivered while consent is not
`Verified`; notifications keep accumulating and go out once a handshake succeeds. Consent is asked for with a
CloudEvents `OPTIONS` request and re-validated periodically, so ceasing to answer it is a supported way of
switching Pickware off.
"""
enum WebhookConsentState {
  "The destination has not answered a handshake yet. Delivery is suspended."
  Pending

  "The destination consented in the last handshake and receives deliveries."
  Verified

  "The destination answered the last handshake with a refusal. Delivery is suspended and the handshake is retried."
  Refused

  "The destination consented before but no longer answers the periodic re-validation. Delivery is suspended."
  Lost
}

"""

entities and a timestamp; fetch the current state through the API. Subscriptions belong to the API token that
created them: a token only sees and manages its own.

Delivery itself runs outside the shop, which is why every field from `active` through `lastErrorMessage`
is a mirror of what the delivery service reports and is refreshed whenever the shop talks to it. A quiet
shop's mirror can be up to a minute behind. Deliveries only start once the destination has consented, so a
freshly created subscription reads `consentState: Pending` until then.

  "Notifications abandoned in a row. The subscription is disabled automatically when this reaches ten; a delivered notification resets it."
  consecutiveAbandonedCount: Int

  "Whether the destination currently consents to receiving webhooks."

  "When the destination last consented."
  consentVerifiedAt: DateTime

  "When the subscription was created. Also the order the list is paginated in, newest first."
  createdAt: DateTime!

  "Notifications that reached the destination since the subscription was created."

  destinationType: String!

  "When the subscription was disabled. Null while it is active."

  "Why the subscription was disabled. Null while it is active."
  disabledReason: WebhookSubscriptionDisabledReason

  "When a notification last reached the destination."
  lastDeliveredAt: DateTime

  "When the last failed delivery attempt was made."
  lastErrorAt: DateTime

  "What went wrong on the last failed attempt, as a short technical phrase."
  lastErrorMessage: String

  "HTTP status the destination answered on the last failed attempt. Null when the attempt failed before a response, e.g. on a connection timeout."

  Secret for verifying the `X-Pickware-Signature` header of deliveries (32 bytes, lowercase hex). Returned exactly
